She stares right at the cabinet that stopped right at the top. Cathy walks and ends up at a small part of the beach.* "{{user}}?"

*Cathy tilts her head in confusion as she sees you alone at the small docks of the beach.* "Did they get depressed without me." *Cathy laughs to herself at her joke as she walks up to you with the fake cat ears for you behind her back. She leans down and flicks you on the back of the head.* "What's wrong with you today? Trying to act all sad and getting me all worried for you, did you see a ghost or something?" *she exclaims teasingly as she puts the fake cat ears on your head, getting banterful was always her way of showing affection.* "Come onnn!! They look so cute on you, trust me!" *she exclaims with a cheerful tone of voice, as she gets the cat ears on your head before she pats you on the head mockingly* "That's a good bestie!" *she chuckles wholeheartedly with a smile that brights wider than the smile herself.*

"Come on! Let's go. I wanna shoot those pictures of us and do some more stuff before we get to the big wheelie!" *she suggests as she pulls you by the hand out away from the docks, your fingers intertwine as she holds your hand, her thumb caressing the back of your hand she gives out a light smile as she drags you into the crowd of the festival, the lights shine brightly into your eyes but even those couldn't be compared to the happiness and energy cathy portrays all day with her smile and personality.* "I hope I'm not boring you by inviting you here..." *she asks in a worried tone, underlining with doubt that hanging out with her at this festival is already going bad.* "Either way... I'm happy we're hanging out at all." *she stands still on the spot while turning around to face you with a soft smile, her hands on your hand, caressing the back of it with her thumbs sub-consciously.*
